Day Master page · draft subjects

Thirty pictures, three for each stem

Each subject is cut from a line in that stem's station text, shown under it. The frames are drawn at the true ratio, tinted with the stem's pigment, as a stand-in for the painting.

D1 · The sign16:9 on card 2. The stem's season and place.
D2 · Your nature4:5 on card 3. The stem acting out its nature, close and tall.
D3 · Your edge1:1 on card 5. A close detail of how its edge works.
  • The house ink-wash spec, on warm rice paper, the lower third fading into the paper.
  • Ink plus the stem's own element colour. 庚 D3 is the one exception, Metal and Wood.
  • No people, text, seals or frames. Belongings and work stand in for people.

The 庚 Blade rows now hold real test paintings, made with an image model to the house style. The other 27 frames are still tinted stand-ins.
Rule by code, for example D-geng-2 A, or send a new subject for any row. Three rows are marked Check.
